claims.text: The building is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world.

findings.quote: this luxurious hotel in downtown Chicago is one of the tallest reinforced concrete buildings in the world

claims.text: The hotel sits along the Chicago River, with views of Navy Pier and its weekly seasonal fireworks show.

findings.quote: situated along the Chicago River, resulting in incredible views of Navy Pier and its weekly seasonal fireworks show

claims.text: The hotel is located near the Magnificent Mile.

findings.quote: Chicago's tallest hotel, complete with unparalleled views of the Chicago River and skyline.

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites have custom designed furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: Our incredibly appointed guest rooms and suites welcome you with custom designed furnishings, floor-to-ceiling windows

claims.text: The hotel offers its signature Trump Attache service.

findings.quote: including the signature Trump Attaché™ service

claims.text: Terrace 16 serves a seasonal New American menu.
Rebar, on the Mezzanine level, offers dining and cocktails along the Chicago River.

findings.quote: Located on the Mezzanine level of Trump Chicago, Rebar provides a casual-chic, dynamic environment for dining and cocktails along the Chicago River.

claims.text: The Spa at Trump overlooks the Chicago skyline.

findings.quote: The Spa at Trump® boasts 23,000 square-feet overlooking the Chicago skyline

claims.text: The hotel features the Anthony Cristiano Salon.

findings.quote: feature the city’s most sought after salon, Anthony Cristiano Salon.

claims.text: The spa offers treatments for individuals and couples.

findings.quote: meticulously crafted for individuals, and couples

claims.text: For events, the hotel has a Grand Ballroom, Salon Rooms and Boardrooms.

findings.quote: The sophisticated design of the Grand Ballroom and incredible views of the Salon Rooms and Boardrooms each offer stunning settings

claims.text: The hotel says the building served as the inspiration for the Burj Khalifa and was designed by the mind behind that Dubai tower.

claims.text: Terrace 16 is a rooftop restaurant on the 16th floor, with an indoor bar and dining room and an outdoor terrace overlooking the Chicago River, Lake Michigan and the city's architecture.

findings.quote: Located on the 16th floor of Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago, the rooftop restaurant features a lively indoor bar and dining room, along with an expansive outdoor terrace overlooking the Chicago River, Lake Michigan

claims.text: Terrace 16 offers views of Chicago's summer fireworks over the river on Wednesdays and Saturdays.

findings.quote: Enjoy front-row views of Chicago's iconic summer fireworks over the river every Wednesday at 9:00pm and Saturday at 10:00pm.

claims.text: Rebar serves Neo Japanese fare created by Kamehachi, with views of the Chicago River and the Michigan Avenue Bridge.

findings.quote: unparalleled vistas of the Chicago River and the city’s famed Michigan Avenue Bridge paired with an ever-evolving menu of Neo Japanese fare created by Kamehachi

claims.text: Every suite has a fully equipped kitchen.

findings.quote: We kindly ask all guests to observe our business and chic casual dress code.

findings.quote: Guests must be 16 years or older to use the Fitness Club. Guests under age 16 must be accompanied by an adult (18+) to use the pool and locker room amenities.
